name: klicktipp
description: KlickTipp toolkit: take an email newsletter from draft through content, audience, sender configuration and test send to dispatch, and read the opt-in processes of a KlickTipp account — over the KlickTipp MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Write, configure and send KlickTipp email newsletters, and read the account's opt-in processes.
interface.longDescription: Connects to the KlickTipp MCP server (https://mcp.klicktipp.com/mcp, OAuth) and exposes two parts of the KlickTipp product API as tools. Newsletters: search and read them, create and update a draft, configure content, audience and sender, send a test, activate the newsletter for dispatch and follow its delivery status. Opt-in: read the account's opt-in processes and their configuration, and resolve the pending or thank-you URL a subscriber is redirected to. Activation reaches real recipients and is a separate, explicitly approved tool call.
defaultPrompt: Show me my opt-in processes and which of them use double opt-in.
Draft a newsletter for the subscribers of my webinar list and send me a test.
What is the delivery status of the newsletter I sent last?
